test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

There is widespread **(prejudice)** against workers over 45.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Intolerance."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Prejudice"** means having a preconceived opinion that is not based on reason or actual experience. (किस व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति प्रबल नापसंदगी या अविश्‍वास, विशेषतः उसकी जाति, धर्म या लिंग के कारण; पूर्वाग्रह)

 
 
• **Example**: *Laws against racial **prejudice**__ must be strictly enforced.*
 
 
 
• **"Intolerance"** means unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or behaviour that differ from one's own. (असहिष्‍णुता, असहनशीलता)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We do not have room for hatred, **intolerance**__, and bigotry.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"intolerance"** is similar in meaning to **"prejudice"** in this context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Misfortune** means bad luck or an unfortunate event. (दुर्भाग्य, विपत्ति या अनर्थ)
 
• **Concern** means a feeling of worry or interest in something. (चिंता; परवाह; चिंताजनक बात)
 
• **Temperament** means a person's nature or personality. 9व्‍यकि्त का स्‍वभाव (विशेषतः जो उसके आचरण और सोच को प्रभावित करे)
